query: MATCH (p:Paper) WHERE p.arxiv_id = '1709.04891' OR p.paper_key IN ['5J5XDKMN', 'SZJE69PE', 'zotero:SZJE69PE'] OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[r]-(n) RETURN elementId(p) AS element_id, p.paper_key AS paper_key, p.title AS title, p.arxiv_id AS arxiv_id, p.doi AS doi, p.url AS url, p.date AS date, p.author AS author, p.source AS source, p.item_type AS item_type, count(r) AS relationship_count, collect(DISTINCT {type: type(r), outgoing: startNode(r) = p, labels: labels(n), paper_key: n.paper_key, name: n.name, key: n.key}) AS relationship_classes ORDER BY paper_key
